name: save_coverage_pack
description: Create or replace a company's complete coverage pack: working thesis, debates with both views, research questions and their model drivers. Reuse the existing company name (check entities) and this company's driver names (check model_drivers). Split 'Is X, or will Y?' into our_view (the side the working thesis takes) and counter_view; if only one side is stated, use its plain negation as counter_view: negate the central outcome without inventing reversals in every contributing factor. Assign each question to the debate it helps resolve. Drivers are the forecast lines the question feeds: 'Model: realized pricing, customer concentration and incremental AWS margins' means three drivers. Save immediately when the mapping is clear, then in your FINAL RESPONSE list the saved thesis, both debate views, and EACH question verbatim under its debate alongside that question's own drivers. Do not just say the pack was saved or verified, and do not collapse questions into a combined driver list. Ask first only if the thesis's side, a question's debate, or its drivers are ambiguous. Always send the COMPLETE pack: omitted active debates/questions are retired. Read the current pack before editing and copy unchanged text exactly; changed wording creates new items assessed from scratch. Labels are cosmetic. After saving, offer email alerts via add_subscription using the returned working thesis_id. The company is always linked to the thesis; thesis_entities supplies optional extra entities.
